name: MOTIS/Transitous Transit
description: Global transit routing and stop data

dataSources.purpose: Global transit data — stops, departures, journey planning with fares, live vehicle radar, trip tracking
dataSources.dataSent: Stop ID, time window, search text, origin and destination coordinates, departure/arrival time, bounding box (for vehicle positions), trip ID
dataSources.dataReceived: Stops with modes, departures/arrivals with delays/cancellations/tracks, itineraries with fares and leg geometry, vehicle positions

dataSources.purpose: Self-hosted transit data — same capabilities as Transitous, coverage depends on loaded GTFS/OSM data
dataSources.dataSent: Stop ID, time window, search text, origin and destination coordinates, departure/arrival time, bounding box (for vehicle positions), trip ID
